newsitem.title: USA: Northern States restores Minn. power plant.
newsitem.headline: Northern States restores Minn. power plant.

text.p: Northern States Power Co's (NSP) coal-fired Allen King power station returned to service earlier this week after being shut on September 27 for tube leak repairs, the company said Thursday.
The plant near Stillwater, Minn., resumed operation Tuesday, it said.
The Allen King facility has a winter net capability of 581 megawatts (MW) and a summer net capacity of 567 MW.
All NSP power plants, who are rated above 150 MW, were in operation, the company added.
